user.title: IKEA BILRESA dimmer
user.description: Gives every IKEA BILRESA dimmer in Matter an event entity for each of its three modes. There is nothing to configure: set up what a mode does in an automation.

abort.single_instance_allowed: IKEA BILRESA dimmer is already set up.
abort.no_fast_matter_switch: Set up Fast Matter switch first.

adjust_light.name: Adjust light
adjust_light.description: Moves the brightness or colour temperature of lights by a number of steps. Use it with a dimmer mode's event: clockwise brightens (or cools), counter-clockwise dims (or warms). A light that is off is switched on by a positive brightness change and left alone by a negative one.

attribute.name: What to adjust
attribute.description: Brightness, or colour temperature (lights in colour temperature mode only).

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: How many steps, negative for dimmer or warmer. The dimmer's wheel events carry it: {{ trigger.to_state.attributes.steps }}.

clicks.name: Clicks
clicks.description: The plain number of wheel clicks, without the speed-up of a long turn: {{ trigger.to_state.attributes.clicks }}. Needed only for the acceleration setting.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.description: How much of the speed-up of a long turn to use, from 0 % (every click moves the same) to 100 % (full speed-up). Works with the clicks.

percent.name: Step size
percent.description: How much one step moves, in percent of the light's range (brightness 0 to 100 %, or the light's colour temperature range).

transition.name: Fade time
transition.description: Seconds the light takes to reach the new value.
